cards.headline:
Whitehall adds in-person
interviews over AI applications
cards.body: Civil service leaders suspect some applications were wholly AI-generated, so Whitehall plans more in-person interviews.

blocks.x: Whitehall is set to increase face-to-face job interviews after a surge in AI-assisted applications to the UK civil service.
In the most extreme cases, civil service leaders suspect that entire applications, including interviewees on video calls, were generated by AI.
